logp.method_description: The partition coefficient was determined from the solubilization of 1 mg of the compound in 300 μL of DMSO. Then, 30 μL of the solution was transferred to a microtube, 750 µL of n-octanol was added, and homogenized. Subsequently, 750 µL of water was added, and the resulting solutions were kept under stirring at 37 °C for 24 h [13]. The absorbance measurements of the complexes in n-octanol/water were performed in triplicate on a SHIMADZU UV-1650PC spectrophotometer. Considering the average absorbance obtained, the concentration value of the complexes in n-octanol and water were determined from the standard curve previously obtained. The standard curve was derived from obtaining spectra after eight successive additions of 50 μL of the solution of the complex in n-octanol into a cuvette containing 2500 μL containing n-octanol. The measure of lipophilicity adopted is the log P, which is the fraction between the concentration of the compound in n-octanol and water, as represented by the equation below: log P = [Compound]n-Oc/[Compound]water [14].
